history.title: Adventures of Dib I: Impregnable Fortress of Dib
history.summary: Expanded from 7 linear pages to 11 richly branching pages with Milo Applecart's intro, Stealth/Perception flanking behind the rear axle, a full Parley/Duel/Firebolt branch with General Dib, hornet-nest sabotage payoff, Bramble the donkey rescue, and Dib's torn Wagon-of-Doom blueprint loot scene.

history.title: Breaching Worm Citadel
history.summary: Deepened from 12 terse pages to 14 atmospheric branching pages with Stealth fang-ridge flanking (FANG_SCOUT), Gizzard dwarven strongbox check, Detect Traps/Arcana pact-seal discovery (PACT_NAME), named Shadow-Fey scout Lyris with decoy-gem sabotage (DECOY_CRACKED), hex-dispelling treasure branch, Firebolt Scriptorium shortcut, Pact-Ledger Alcove sabotage (CONTRACT_BURNED), and the white cat Moonlit Court familiar payoff.

history.title: Empire of the Ghouls III: The Blood Marriage
history.summary: Replaced 3 one-line filler pages and expanded into a full 11-page Northlands chapter with Shield-Captain Brynhild, a playable Ragnarok bonfire raid (Stealth/Firebolt), Spear Maiden sun-oil blessing (SUN_OIL), glacier ice-chimney bypass to the Obsidian Parapet with chain-dropping brazier sabotage (BRAZIER_DROPPED), Turn Undead aisle-clearing (CHOIR_BROKEN), and an interactive Eclipse-Chalice purification climax.

history.title: Hell Comes a' Glittering
history.summary: Replaced 3 one-line filler pages and expanded into a full 11-page urban gothic mystery with 3 investigative leads (Morgue ruby-salt & Seventh Debt note, Alley witness coal-chute stakeout, and Vaelor's parlor interrogation), Stealth/Lockpicking/Detect Traps cellar flanking (CELLAR_FLANK), Vaelor's sonic tuning-fork confession payoff (SONIC_FORK -> CARAPACE_CRACKED), Crystal Homunculi mid-boss encounter, and interactive pentagram purification.

history.title: Under the Devil's Thumb
history.summary: Replaced filler pages and expanded into a 10-page Highgate sewer heist with Detect Traps/Stealth aqueduct bypass, a bronze flood-valve shortcut washing away the Umber checkpoint (FLOOD_FLUSHED), a captive apothecary negotiation/stealth scene yielding plague-antidote (PLAGUE_ANTIDOTE), a trapped cedar coffer side-loot check, and a spice-bazaar rooftop escape back to Sister Starkfeather's sanctuary.

history.title: Bastion of the Deranged
history.summary: Expanded from 10 terse pages to 13 branching pages with Caravan-Master Tovin's missing salt-train hook, a drainage culvert Stealth entry, revivable petrified Outrider Bram (BRAM_RESCUED -> grounding-chain sabotage CRYSTAL_SHATTERED & reunion bonus), Bat Roost stampede sabotage (BATS_STAMPEDED), Turn Undead/Firebolt/Herbalism Fungus Garden routes into the Barracks Alcove air-shaft (GRAKNIR_FLANKED), and a 3-weakness boss showdown.

history.title: Scarlet Citadel III: The Dwarven Barracks
history.summary: Replaced 3 one-line filler pages and expanded into a 12-page mega-dungeon chapter with Stealth/Lockpicking/Arcana ward-chime entries (RAIDER_FLANKED), the Dwarven Ring-Mage Forge & Cold-Iron Resonance Bell (RESONANCE_BELL -> SWARM_DISRUPTED), captive Redtower Scout Mira rescue in Sergeants' Quarters (MIRA_SCOUT -> pitch-brazier sabotage CHIEF_AMBUSHED & winch bonus), hidden journal trade-rings, and seamless handoff to Part 4.

history.title: Grandmother's Fire
history.summary: Expanded from 6 terse pages to 12 Slavic-folklore branching pages with woodcutter Vasily's rescue from Ghost Knights of Doresh (Turn Undead/Stealth), Doresh's Frost-Seal saddlebag clue (CHAIN_KNOWN), a full interactive parley at Baba Yaga's chicken-legged hut (BABA_EMBER -> POOL_BOILED & Grandmother's 50 GP parting nod), sunken anchor-chain sabotage (CHAIN_SNAPPED), and a drowned toll-chest loot branch.

history.title: The Obsidian Pass
history.summary: Removed sourcebook leak ('Prepared! Conquered') and expanded from 6 linear pages to 12 dramatic branching pages with Elder Sylvara's hook, volcanic rockslide/druidic root-ward/shadow-fissure stealth options (GORGE_AMBUSH), uncovering the psychic tether on Archmage Vaeloria (VAELORIA_TRUTH -> VAELORIA_ALLY redemption & 150 GP penance bonus), Firebolt/Ward-Glass sunlight sabotage (RIFT_FRACTURED), and starlight crystal loot.

history.title: Empire of the Ghouls V: Into the Fuligin Realm
history.summary: Replaced 3 one-line filler pages and expanded into a 12-page Underworld chapter with kobold courier Skrik, a full parley scene at Narosain the Last King's court (LAST_KING_PACT & DRAGON_BLINDSPOT), Withered Hand shrine Marrowblight dispatch & sonic-phosphorus ampoules (PHOSPHORUS_CHALK -> DRAGON_AMBUSHED), Gondecap's dwarven ash-hoard strongbox (110 GP), and Narosain's Vandekhul loyalist countersign scene (80 GP).

history.title: Trouble at Mossbeard Mill II: Missing Pieces
history.summary: Expanded from 8 terse pages to 12 atmospheric branching pages with Moonbright's twilight parley oath scene (TRUCE_BROKERED), a boathouse catwalk sabotage & cult-ledger infiltration branch (BEAM_DROPPED, CULT_LEDGER, Firebolt shortcut), oil-trail containment (FIRE_CONTAINED), a fog-shrouded river barge ferrymen rescue & Turn Undead tactical scene (FERRYMEN_SAVED), sinking barge strongbox salvage (BARGE_COFFER, 35 GP), and militia rallying at the Northcord Barricade.

history.title: A Bad Night for Betting
history.summary: Replaced 3 one-line filler pages and expanded from 6 linear pages to 11 gritty frontier-town branching pages with Pit-Master Korrin's spectator evacuation (CROWD_SAVED), betting-booth catwalk infiltration against peddler Vexil (ALCHEMIST_SPOTTED, CART_SABOTAGED, WAGER_BOX_LOOTED 95 GP, Firebolt shortcut), copper-trough lime-ash neutralizer investigation (NEUTRALIZER_READY), and a heartwarming dogmole-pup rescue scene (PUPS_CALMED, 45 GP).

history.title: Part II: The Phylactery Throne of Malakor
history.summary: Deepened from 12 to 14 atmospheric pages with upper-gallery Stealth scouting against the Dread-Guard (VANGUARD_FLANKED), a new Crypt of Weeping Banners side-vault with Dawn-Watch oath blessing (BANNER_BLESSED, +10 HP, +30 GP), a Turn Undead radiant conduit overload branch (CONDUIT_BROKEN, +20 XP), and richer prose throughout.

history.title: Trollkin Hunt
history.summary: Expanded from 7 terse pages to 11 richly branching pages with hydra-track Survival scouting (HYDRA_STUDIED), a Cypress Root-Walk ambush bypass yielding marsh antidotes (ANTIDOTE_READY, +15 HP, +45 XP), a Sunken Offering-Shrine sabotage & Firebolt branch (SHRINE_DOUSED +120 GP, REEDS_TORCHED), and an interactive Trollkin Reaver parley payoff for HONORED_TROLLKIN.

history.title: The Warlock's Crypt
history.summary: Expanded from 7 terse pages to 11 gothic branching pages with the hidden Queen's Alcove silver locket & Dawn-oil (MOTHER_LOCKET -> SONS_SHAKEN payoff naming Aurelian & Cassian), a Moon-Shaft Reliquary mirror-angle & Turn Undead tactical branch (MOONLIGHT_REFLECTED, SHAFT_BLESSED, OFFERTORY_LOOTED +105 GP), and the Shattered Plinth debt-ledger salvage (+75 GP, +25 XP).

history.title: Lost Halls of Everforge
history.summary: Replaced one-line filler pages and expanded from 8 linear pages to 11 richly branching pages with Polla's threshold hook, Detect Traps brass-spring salvage (DART_DISARMED), interactive Ancestral Throne blessing (EVERFORGE_BLESSED), Smelter's Alcove rift diagram & iron-ore cache (BELLOWS_CLUE), Upper Bellows Gallery stealth bypass & Firebolt/Athletics flue-damper sabotage (RIFT_STARVED), and an interactive Sage Spencius reckoning scene (SPENCIUS_BOUND / SPENCIUS_CAPTURED).

history.title: Part II: The Heart of the Blight-Wood
history.summary: Deepened from 10 terse pages to 13 richly atmospheric branching pages with Ranger Lyra's descent briefing, a High Root-Gallery Stealth/fern-arch flank & lost scout cairn (ROOT_FLANKED, 25 GP, glowcap_spores), Athletics/Herbalism/Firebolt vine crossing (VINES_CLEARED), a new Blight-Node Fissure sabotage side-scene (Turn Undead/Arcana -> NODE_SEVERED + 20 GP amber) that also weakens Malgroot, and a sunlit canopy reunion scene with Lyra.

history.title: Respite at Rough Run
history.summary: Expanded from 8 linear pages to 11 richly branching infiltration pages with Detect Traps sluice-pinning, a new Smuggler's Barge-Loft entry & captive river-pilot Oren rescue (GALLERY_FLANKED, +40 GP, dumbwaiter Stealth bypass), a Gear-Shaft Vault flywheel/Firebolt sabotage branch (SWORDS_JAMMED, +55 GP), a copper speaking-tube bluff against Kael & Korra (TWINS_RATTLED), and a celebratory dockside bonfire scene.

history.title: Lost and Found
history.summary: Fixed invalid 'lore' stat check to Arcana and expanded from 8 linear pages to 11 branching urban-caper pages with a Bookshop Alley Courier's Dead-Drop side-scene (COURIER_KEY, +35 GP, Vesper's bribe-slip), HOUSE_KNOWN instant-trust branch with RS, coal-chute Stealth flank, Rooftop Eaves bribed watchman & Firebolt fireworks sabotage (WATCHMAN_GONE / VESPER_DAZZLED), and a Loose Ends Tied epilogue bonus (+35 GP).

history.title: A Starry Breach
history.summary: Replaced 4 one-line filler pages and expanded from 1 single fight to a full 10-page frozen-wastes expedition with Halvar's ridge hook (RIFT_STUDIED), Stealth/camp investigation yielding Cartographer Elin's journal & Silver Counter-Fork (SILVER_FORK, +8 HP, 35 GP), Void-Touched Ice Mephits skirmish, Eastern Rune-Cairn sabotage via SILVER_FORK/Firebolt/Arcana (ANCHOR_BROKEN), and an interactive breach-closing climax.

history.title: The Smuggler's Cove of Saltfang
history.summary: Deepened from 22 to 24 atmospheric pages: wired previously orphaned Page 20 into 'The Silver Wake' ghost-crew farewell (+20 GP, +15 XP), added a new Sunken Bell-Buoy side-branch (BELL_RUNG weakens all Dreadtide undead + 20 GP), added interactive Firebolt powder-keg sabotage on the Gun Deck (DECK_SHAKEN), added Spirit/Persuasion prayer option at the Sea-Witch's Alcove, added Might chest-pry at Barnacle Arch, and added Vex's Dockside Rendezvous (+6 HP) before the Rogue Ending.

history.title: Salvage at Lonely Cove
history.summary: Expanded from 6 to 10 pages with Tamsin the sea-cave survivor side-scene, Sunken Chart-Room manifest & lockbox, hidden strongbox compartment, cliff-winch spring tide hazard, and dual harbor broker endings.

history.title: The Lost Forge
history.summary: Expanded from 6 to 10 pages with Captain Thorek Ironpike voice, Upper Bellows Gallery furnace sabotage, Ancestral Clan Vault reliquary, stolen caravan strongboxes, molten crucible quenching hazard, and dual mountain clan endings.

history.title: Fungal Forest of Forgetting
history.summary: Expanded from 10 to 13 pages with Memory-Cap Hollow (SPORE_IMMUNITY), Spore-Distillery Vat (LYE_FLASK), Perception tripwire option, Athletics toadstool-cut option, richer prose/voice, and Savior of the Forgotten bonus ending.

history.title: The Rune Crypt of Sianis
history.summary: Expanded from 7 to 11 pages with Korrak the ravenfolk doom croaker parley, Mourning Reliquary counter-rune side-scene, dark rune unmaking ritual, Helari Silver Alcove, and Redeemer of House Helari bonus ending.

history.title: The Ravencrest Bandit Citadel
history.summary: Expanded from 10 to 13 pages with North Watchtower signal brazier sabotage, Captured Caravan Drivers cellar rescue (DRIVERS_FREED + secret stair bypass), richer Warlord Vane prose, and Savior of the Trade Road bonus ending.

history.title: Nightfell VI: Vengeance is Mine
history.summary: Expanded 6-chapter finale from 12 to 15 pages with Alacia Deserete's Ward-Chamber (ALCHEMICAL_COUNTER/ENCLAVE_MAP), Six Names on the Cairn memorial (DAUGHTERS_NAMED), Turn Undead & merciful skull ritual (fixed invalid Lore skill), and Redeemer of Nightfell bonus ending.

history.title: The Clockwork Foundry of Brasshaven
history.summary: Expanded from 12 to 15 pages: fixed invalid Tinkering skill checks to Lockpicking/Detect Traps, added pressure-gauge VALVE_MAP route, Boiler Gallery rescue of Pip's apprentice Bramwell (BRAMWELL_SAVED + Firebolt/Athletics/VALVE_MAP options + breather heal), Capacitor Siphon sabotage (SIPHON_DRAINED), and a rescue bonus on the True Ending.

history.title: The Gloomfen Witch-Bog
history.summary: Expanded from 12 to 15 pages with Reedy Shallows rescue of Old Fenwick the peat-cutter (Herbalism/Firebolt/Athletics -> FENWICK_SAVED, +18 GP, +6 HP, +3 MP), the Willow of Trapped Lanterns sabotage branch (LANTERNS_BROKEN via salt-ash/Arcana/Luck), and a Fenwick & Marta gratitude bonus (+30 GP, +25 XP) on the True Ending.

history.title: The River of Alchemy
history.summary: Expanded from 7 to 11 pages: fixed invalid stat:'lore' to stat:'arcana', added Reedy Weir encounter with Haldor the Mill-Wright (Herbalism/Athletics -> SLUICE_KEY, +45 GP, +12 HP/+4 MP, waterwheel crab-bypass), Reagent Vault side-scene (Detect Traps/Luck -> VESSIK_LEDGER + 65 GP, Firebolt condenser sabotage), and dual endings.

history.title: Crater of the Flaying Star
history.summary: Expanded from 6 to 10 pages with Princess Mynna's West Ridge Star-Shrine (Arcana/Persuasion -> MYNNA_BLESSING, +40 GP, +10 HP/+4 MP, skylight bypass), Scribe's Vault treasury & obsidian mirror sabotage (Detect Traps/Turn Undead/Luck -> STAR_MIRROR + 55 GP), Mynna's tribute bonus (+50 GP/+35 XP), and Star-Glass Prospector victory ending.

history.title: Swept Away
history.summary: Expanded from 7 to 11 pages with Stone-Keeper Corwin's warning, East Knoll Brass Echo-Pylon sabotage (Firebolt/Detect Traps/Athletics -> PYLON_SILENCED, +55 GP, +12 HP/+4 MP), Hedgerow Flank gale-imp bypass, Corwin's monolith bonus (+65 GP/+40 XP), and Broker of Infernal Strings victory ending.

history.title: Caverns of the Spore Lord
history.summary: Expanded from 8 to 11 pages with Elder Maren's Longhouse side-scene (LIME_ASH, +15 GP, +6 HP), Detect Traps salvage at Dusstan's Folly (+20 GP), Hero's Rest antidote-mist brewing (LIME_ASH/Herbalism/Firebolt -> SPORE_CURE + waterway bypass + merciful Enok cure bonus), and Cavern Harvester victory ending.

history.title: Storming the Queen's Desire
history.summary: Expanded from 7 to 11 pages with Foremast Crow's Nest rescue of cabin boy Toby (TOBY_RESCUED, +35 GP, +8 HP/+3 MP, Detect Traps/Firebolt thunder-wire sabotage -> WIRE_CUT), Gun-Deck Bilge Baron's Bribe-Chest (Lockpicking -> BARON_CONTRACT + 45 GP + stern-window cabin flank + 50 GP harbormaster bonus), and Messori Privateer victory ending.

history.title: The Clattering Keep
history.summary: Expanded from 7 to 11 pages with West Undercroft rescue of captive stonemason Garran (Lockpicking/Athletics -> GARRAN_FREED, +35 GP, +8 HP/+3 MP, chapel stair bypass), Rookery Gallery flawed binding-stone sabotage (GARRAN_FREED/Turn Undead/Detect Traps -> CIRCLE_CRACKED + 45 GP), Garran's guild rescue bonus (+45 GP/+30 XP), and Raider of Keep Yellete victory ending.

history.title: The Cistern
history.summary: Expanded from 7 linear pages to 11 branching pages with brick service-flue Lockpicking/Perception entry, Hada's Sealed Study (Arcana/Detect Traps -> DRAKE_WHISTLE + 95 GP, +15 HP/+5 MP, storm-sluice ghoul bypass), Cistern Overflow ambush (DRAKE_WHISTLE/Turn Undead/Firebolt -> DRAKE_RATTLED), Inquisitor intel bonus (+85 GP/+55 XP), and Slayer of the Deep Drake victory ending.

history.title: Hunters of the Tenebrous Plain
history.summary: Expanded from 6 to 10 pages with Riverbank Ferry-Post Ribbon-Tree (Herbalism/Arcana -> RIBBON_FREED, +22 GP, +6 HP/+3 MP, reed-ditch bypass), Oma's Lantern-Shed Jars of Stolen Laughter (RIBBON_FREED/Firebolt/Lockpicking -> LAUGHS_FREED + 35 GP), family ribbon bonus (+30 GP/+25 XP), and Raider of the Black Hearth victory ending.

history.title: Scarlet Citadel I: The Ruins Above & Gaoler's Crypt
history.summary: Expanded Part 1 of 7 from 7 to 11 pages with ruined buttery Lockpicking entry, Holzanger Crypts encounter with herbalist Veda (Persuasion/Turn Undead -> CHARUN_WARD, POPPY_DRAUGHT, +25 GP, +6 HP/+3 MP), Guard Pantry wine-cask sabotage (OGRE_DRUGGED bypassing Scar, Detect Traps +35 GP, Firebolt smoke), Veda rescue bonus (+30 GP/+25 XP), and Raider victory ending.

history.title: The Returners' Tower
history.summary: Expanded from 7 to 11 pages with ivy bell-rope Athletics climb, Mid-Tower Bell-Loft rescue of clerk Corin (Persuasion/Arcana -> CORIN_SAVED, +40 GP, +10 HP/+4 MP, Conduit Gallery bypass), Four Copper Busbars sabotage (CORIN_SAVED/Detect Traps +55 GP/Firebolt -> CONDUIT_CUT), mayor rescue bonus (+50 GP/+35 XP), and Planar Salvager victory ending.

history.title: Raiders of the Chamber of Tomorrows
history.summary: Expanded from 7 to 11 pages (removed 3 one-line filler epilogue pages, fixed invalid Acrobatics skill to Athletics), adding warehouse fuse-snipping (Detect Traps +25 GP -> THORN_CHART), Sunken Causeway rearguard skirmish, Domed Apex chrono-ward check (Arcana -> TIME_WARD_CALMED), Effervescent Boathouse limpet-mine sabotage & starlight cordial (SKIFF_TUNED +40 GP/+30 XP or +10 HP/+4 MP/+30 GP), Firebolt/SKIFF_TUNED rapids advantage (RIVER_LEAD), and rich Reywald Sanctuary epilogue.

history.title: Stormcaller's Tower
history.summary: Expanded from 9 to 12 pages (fixed invalid Acrobatics skill to Athletics), adding rain-gutter Athletics infiltration (GUTTER_INFILTRATOR bypassing Entry Hall), Lower Maintenance Gallery rescue of captive weather-seer Warden Torin (Lockpicking/Athletics -> WARDEN_FREED +65 GP/+40 XP), Surge Room Torin shutdown & Detect Traps relay-bar sabotage (COILS_DRAINED +6 MP/+30 XP), Outer Storm-Balcony scouting (Firebolt / Perception -> EYE_OF_STORM), and Warden Torin's Valley Keep tribute (+90 GP/+50 XP/+20 HP).

history.title: Redoubt of the Perfidious Guru
history.summary: Expanded from 6 to 10 pages with Brimstone Censer unmasking (INCENSE_EXPOSED +20 XP), prayer-flag cliff Athletics flank (CLIFF_FLANK bypassing Terrace guards), Dormitory Cloister encounter with Acolyte Tenzin (Persuasion/Arcana -> TENZIN_TRUST +35 GP/+8 HP/+4 MP or MIRROR_FLAW), Sub-Floor Gallery Soul-Mirror sabotage (Detect Traps +45 GP/Firebolt -> MIRROR_CRACKED), and Tenzin's gratitude bonus (+50 GP/+35 XP/+5 MP).

history.title: Fight for Horseshoe Rock Oasis
history.summary: Expanded from 6 to 10 pages (removed 3 one-line filler epilogue pages), adding Stealth rescue of pinned Outrider Tariq (OUTRIDER_SAVED +55 GP/+12 HP/+4 MP), Survival/Firebolt/Athletics predator turf-war lure (PREDATORS_BLOODIED weakening both bosses), Waterfall Sunken Cistern side-scene (Lockpicking +75 GP or Herbalism +14 HP/+5 MP -> NEST_BLINDSPOT), and Tariq's gratitude bonus (+80 GP/+45 XP).

history.title: The Midnight Tree
history.summary: Expanded from 9 to 12 pages (cleaned Old Margreve sourcebook tag to Margreve Forest), adding root-arch Stealth scouting (SNARES_CLEARED +15 GP), Kitchen Loft poppy-ash wine sabotage & Firebolt chimney smoke (WINE_DRUGGED), Treasure Chamber knothole scouting (CHIEFTAIN_STUDIED), Canopy Ledge falconer's whistle check (RAVENS_RATTLED), and Courier Alaric's dawn gratitude bonus (+35 GP/+25 XP/+8 HP).
